tools.name: commit
tools.command: if jj root >/dev/null 2>&1; then jj commit -m {{message}}; else git commit -m {{message}}; fi
tools.description: Commit the current working copy in repository with a specified message.
guidelines: Use when work is done, before starting new work.

tools.name: project_status
tools.command: if jj root >/dev/null 2>&1; then jj status; else git status; fi
tools.description: Shows the current working copy status in the project.
guidelines: Use to check what files are modified before committing or to orient in the current state.

tools.name: jj_log
tools.description: View commits in the jj log for the project.
guidelines: Use to orient in version control state or verify recent commits.
Default shows mutable revisions. Use revisions param for other sets (e.g., 'all()', 'open()').

tools.name: jj_describe
tools.description: Set or update the commit description on the current working copy in a jj repository.
guidelines: Use to describe upcoming changes before or after making them
Message should follow conventional commit format when appropriate

tools.name: jj_new
tools.description: Create a new empty change

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh pr create --title {{title}} --head {{head}} {{--draft?}} --assignee @me --body {{body}}
tools.description: Creates a GitHub pull request from the current branch, assigning it to yourself.
guidelines: For jj repos, pass the bookmark name as the --head parameter
For regular git repos, pass the current branch name as --head

tools.name: create_bookmark
tools.description: Creates or moves a jj bookmark pointing at a specified revision, typically in preparation for pushing a PR.

tools.name: push_bookmark
tools.description: Pushes a jj bookmark to the remote Git repository.

tools.name: create_github_issue
tools.description: Creates a GitHub issue in the current repository.

tools.name: reply_to_pr_review_comment
tools.command: gh api repos/{{owner}}/{{repo}}/pulls/{{pr_number}}/comments/{{comment_id}}/replies --method POST -f body={{body}} -q '{id: .id, body: .body, created_at: .created_at, html_url: .html_url}'
tools.description: Replies to a PR review comment on GitHub. Returns the reply's id, body, creation time, and URL.

tools.name: fetch_pr_review_comments
tools.command: gh api repos/{{owner}}/{{repo}}/pulls/{{pr_number}}/comments --jq '.[] | {id, path, body, line, side, author: .user.login, created_at}'
tools.description: Fetches inline code review comments on a pull request to see reviewer feedback.

tools.name: edit_pull_request
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh pr edit {{pr_number}} --title {{title}} --body {{body}}
tools.description: Updates an existing GitHub pull request's title and body.

tools.name: edit_revision
tools.description: Switch the working copy to an existing revision for editing.

tools.name: view_jira_issue
tools.description: View a Jira issue's details, optionally filtering to specific fields.

tools.name: search_jira_issues
tools.description: Search Jira issues using JQL and return key, summary, status, type, and assignee for matching issues.
guidelines: max_results defaults to 50 if empty
Quote JQL with spaces via placeholder

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Creates a new git branch and switches to it.

tools.name: stage_files
tools.description: Stages specified files for commit. Use '.' or '-A' to stage all changes.

tools.name: push_branch
tools.description: Pushes a local branch to the origin remote and sets it as the upstream tracking branch.

tools.name: create_jira_issue
tools.description: Creates a new Jira issue via REST API and returns the issue key and browse URL.
guidelines: json_body is raw JSON for POST /rest/api/3/issue

tools.name: edit_jira_issue
tools.description: Updates an existing Jira issue's fields via the REST API.

tools.name: list_jira_comments
tools.description: Lists comments on a Jira issue ordered oldest-first, showing author, timestamp, and plain-text body.

tools.name: list_jira_issue_links
tools.description: Lists all issue links on a Jira issue with link type, direction, and linked issue details.

tools.name: create_jira_blocks_link
tools.description: Creates a 'Blocks' link between two Jira issues where A blocks B.

tools.name: create_jira_split_link
tools.description: Creates a 'Work item split' link between two Jira issues (A split to B).

tools.name: delete_jira_blocks_link
tools.description: Deletes a 'Blocks' link between two Jira issues.

tools.name: delete_jira_split_link
tools.description: Deletes a 'Work item split' link between two Jira issues.

tools.name: view_failed_run_logs
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh run view {{run_id}} --log-failed
tools.description: Fetches and displays logs from failed jobs in a GitHub Actions run.

tools.name: squash_into_destination
tools.description: Move changes from a source jj revision or revset into a destination change while preserving the destination change's commit message.
guidelines: Use optional filesets to limit the squash to specific files or paths; omit them to squash all changes.
Inspect the result with jj log or jj status before running another history-editing command.

tools.name: view_pr_comments
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh pr view {{pr_number}} --comments --json comments --jq '.comments[] | {author: .author.login, body: .body, createdAt: .createdAt}'
tools.description: Fetches top-level (non-inline) comments on a GitHub pull request.

tools.name: fetch_pr_reviews
tools.command: gh api repos/{{owner}}/{{repo}}/pulls/{{pr_number}}/reviews --jq '.[] | {id, author: .user.login, state, body, submitted_at: .submitted_at}'
tools.description: Fetches PR review submissions (approvals, change requests, comments) for a given pull request.

tools.name: show_diff
tools.description: Show the diff of pending changes using jj.

tools.name: jj_undo
tools.description: Undoes the last jj operation, restoring the previous repo state.

tools.name: list_ci_runs
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh run list --limit {{limit}} --json databaseId,status,conclusion,headBranch,name,event --jq '.[] | {id: .databaseId, status, conclusion, branch: .headBranch, name, event}'
tools.description: Lists recent GitHub Actions CI runs with their status, conclusion, branch, and ID.

tools.name: comment_on_pr
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh pr comment {{pr_number}} --body {{body}}
tools.description: Posts a top-level comment on a GitHub pull request.

tools.name: download_jira_attachments
tools.description: Downloads attachments from a Jira issue into /tmp/jira-attachments/{{key}}
guidelines: list via view_jira_issue attachment field

tools.name: restore_files
tools.description: Restores the given paths in the working copy from the parent revision, discarding their local changes.
guidelines: Discards working-copy changes to listed paths

tools.name: amend_commit_message
tools.description: Rewrites the most recent commit's message in place.
guidelines: Force-push after amending a pushed commit

tools.name: force_push_branch
tools.description: Force-pushes a branch to origin only if the remote hasn't changed since the last fetch.
guidelines: Fetch first for accurate lease check

tools.name: get_pr_content
tools.description: Fetches the title and body of a pull request as JSON.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Shows unstaged changes in the git working copy.

tools.name: obsidian_daily_append
tools.description: Append content to today's daily note.

tools.name: view_github_issue
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh issue view {{issue}} --json title,body,labels,state,assignees
tools.description: Views a GitHub issue with key metadata and body.

tools.name: abandon_jj_change
tools.description: Abandons a specified Jujutsu change from the repository history.
guidelines: Use only for obsolete changes

tools.name: check_github_auth_and_default_branch
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh auth status && GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq .defaultBranchRef.name
tools.description: Verifies GitHub CLI authentication and prints the repository default branch name.

tools.name: view_ci_run_jobs
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh run view {{run_id}} --json status,conclusion,createdAt,updatedAt,url,jobs --jq '{status, conclusion, createdAt, updatedAt, url, jobs: [.jobs[] | {name, status, conclusion, startedAt, completedAt, url, steps: [.steps[]? | {name, status, conclusion, number, startedAt, completedAt}]}]}'
tools.description: Shows job and step status details for a GitHub Actions workflow run without dumping logs.
guidelines: Use numeric run id

tools.name: view_full_ci_run_logs
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh run view {{run_id}} --log
tools.description: Fetches the full plain-text logs for all jobs in a GitHub Actions workflow run.

tools.name: view_current_branch_pr
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh pr view --json url,number,title --jq '{url, number, title}'
tools.description: Shows the open GitHub pull request associated with the current branch, including URL, number, and title.

tools.name: fetch_pr_diff
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh pr diff {{pr_ref}} --color=never
tools.description: Fetches the final GitHub pull request diff against its base using authenticated gh access.

tools.name: switch_branch
tools.description: Switches the current Git worktree to an existing branch.
guidelines: Ensure worktree is clean

tools.name: list_github_issues
tools.command: GIT_DIR=$(jj git root 2>/dev/null || echo .git) gh issue list {{--state state?}} {{--limit limit?}} --json number,title,state,labels,assignees --jq '.[] | {number, title, state, labels: [.labels[].name], assignees: [.assignees[].login]}'
tools.description: Lists GitHub issues in the current repository with summary fields for selecting an issue to inspect.
guidelines: State: open, closed, all

tools.name: inspect_git_history
tools.description: Shows a compact decorated commit graph for recent Git history.

tools.name: continue_rebase
tools.description: Continues an in-progress Git rebase without opening an editor, preserving the existing commit message.
guidelines: Resolve and stage conflicts first

tools.name: rebase_revision
tools.description: Reorganizes local Jujutsu history by moving a selected revision onto a new base.
guidelines: Use unambiguous revision IDs or revsets.
Inspect history before and after rebasing.
